summary.short: Colombia's Law 2466 of 2025 amends the Labor Code on contracts, working hours, discipline, discrimination, apprenticeships, telework and subcontracting, and creates a hiring subsidy. Rules for digital delivery-platform workers, including automated-system transparency and human review, apply only after a later regulatory trigger (Art. 67).
summary.long: Law 2466 of 2025, dated 25 June 2025, amends the Substantive Labour Code and other labour norms. It covers fixed-term and indefinite contracts, disciplinary due process, working hours and overtime limits, surcharges for rest-day work, employer duties including disability hiring quotas (two workers per 100 for firms up to 500 staff), bans on discrimination and workplace violence and harassment, apprenticeship and internship rules, joint liability in subcontracting and limits on temporary staffing, telework including transnational telework, and the CREA EMPLEO hiring benefit funded from the national budget. Articles 24 to 30 regulate digital delivery (reparto) platforms: worker categories, a platform company contribution of 60% to health and pension contributions for independent workers, registration of platform companies with the Labour Ministry, information to workers on automated supervision and decision systems, personal-data processing limited to authorised purposes, periodic impact evaluation, and a right to request human review. Those articles take effect 12 months after the government completes their regulation and implementation (Art. 67). The Labour Ministry supervises compliance, the UGPP oversees contributions, and Art. 48 sets a daily wage indemnity for fraudulent use of sector or microenterprise privileges, capped at 24 months.

La continuada subordinación o dependencia del trabajador o trabajadora respecto del empleador
ni a las micro y pequeñas empresas de menos de diez (10) trabajadores, definidas en el Decreto 957 de 2019.
Se entenderá por microempresa aquella definida de acuerdo con el Decreto 957 de 2019 o la norma que lo sustituya o modifique.

definitions.defined_in: Ley 1221 de 2008, Art. 2(1) as replaced by this instrument, Art. 52

evidence.quote: Teletrabajo. Es una modalidad laboral, que se efectúa en el marco de un contrato de trabajo o de una relación laboral dependiente, que consiste en el desempeño de actividades remuneradas utilizando como soporte las Tecnologías de la Información y la Comunicación (TIC)

definitions.defined_in: Ley 1221 de 2008, Art. 2(2) as replaced by this instrument, Art. 52

evidence.quote: Persona que desempeña actividades laborales a través de tecnologías de la información y la comunicación por fuera de la empresa a la que presta sus servicios.

definitions.defined_in: Ley 1221 de 2008, Art. 2(1)(d) as replaced by this instrument, Art. 52

evidence.provision: Art. 52 (modifying Ley 1221 de 2008, Art. 2, num. 1, lit. d)
evidence.quote: Teletrabajo transnacional: es aquel en donde los teletrabajadores y teletrabajadoras de una relación laboral celebrada en Colombia laboran desde otro país

definitions.defined_in: Código Sustantivo del Trabajo, Art. 34(1) as replaced by this instrument, Art. 44

evidence.provision: Art. 44 (replacing Código Sustantivo del Trabajo, Art. 34, num. 1)
evidence.quote: Son contratistas y subcontratistas, personas naturales o jurídicas quienes contraten en beneficio de terceros, cualquiera que sea el acto que le dé origen

obligations.summary: Employer may not agree a penalty on a worker who omits the 30-day notice required for indefinite-term contract termination.

evidence.quote: En ningún caso se podrá pactar sanción para el empleado que omita el preaviso aquí descrito.

obligations.summary: Fixed-term and work-or-task contracts must be in writing; otherwise they are deemed indefinite-term from the start of the relationship.

evidence.quote: El contrato de trabajo a término fijo deberá celebrarse por escrito.

obligations.summary: Disciplinary sanction proceedings must observe minimum due-process steps (written notice, evidence transfer, response period of at least 5 days, reasoned decision, right to appeal); micro and small employers of fewer than 10 workers only must hear the worker beforehand.

evidence.quote: En todas las actuaciones para aplicar sanciones disciplinarias, se deberán aplicar las garantías del debido proceso

obligations.summary: Employer must update the internal work regulations to the disciplinary procedure parameters.

evidence.quote: El empleador deberá actualizar el Reglamento Interno de Trabajo, acorde con los parámetros descritos dentro de los doce (12) meses siguientes a la entrada en vigencia de la presente Ley

obligations.summary: Ministry of Labour must promote an accompaniment and strengthening programme for micro and small firms on due process.

evidence.quote: Dentro de los doce (12) meses siguientes a la entrada en vigencia de la presente ley, el Ministerio del Trabajo impulsará un programa de acompañamiento y fortalecimiento a micro y pequeñas empresas

obligations.summary: Employer must publish the work regulations by posting two legible copies in two places and through a virtual medium accessible to workers at any time; optional digital dispatch.

evidence.quote: el empleador debe publicar el reglamento de trabajo

obligations.summary: National Government must implement programmes for job generation and protection (Art. 160 paragraph 1).

evidence.quote: El Gobierno nacional implementará programas dirigidos a la generación y protección de empleos

obligations.summary: Maximum ordinary working day of 8 hours and 42 hours per week; night-shift work carries a night surcharge; subject to the gradual application under Law 2101 of 2021 and the listed exceptions (flexible schedules, minors, shift work).

evidence.quote: tendrá derecho al pago de recargo nocturno

obligations.summary: Government may order a reduction of working hours in especially unhealthy or dangerous work, according to expert opinions.

evidence.quote: el Gobierno puede ordenar la reducción de la jornada de trabajo

obligations.summary: Employer must keep an overtime record per worker, give the worker a statement on request with payment proof, and provide the record to judicial and administrative authorities when required.

evidence.quote: El empleador deberá llevar un registro del trabajo suplementario de cada trabajador

obligations.summary: Overtime may not exceed 2 hours per day and 12 per week.

evidence.quote: En ningún caso las horas extras de trabajo, diurnas o nocturnas, podrán exceder de dos (2) horas diarias y doce (12) semanales.

obligations.summary: Work on compulsory rest days is paid with a surcharge: 80% from 1 July 2025.

evidence.quote: A partir del primero de julio de 2025, se incrementará el recargo por laborar en día de descanso obligatorio a 80%.

obligations.summary: Work on compulsory rest days is paid with a surcharge: 90% from 1 July 2026.

evidence.quote: A partir del primero de julio de 2026, se incrementará el recargo por laborar en día de descanso obligatorio a 90%.

obligations.summary: Full 100% surcharge for work on compulsory rest days applies from 1 July 2027.

evidence.quote: A partir del primero de julio de 2027, se dará plena aplicación al recargo por laborar día de descanso obligatorio

obligations.summary: Employer must grant paid leave for listed cases (voting, official duties, domestic calamity, union duties, urgent medical appointments, school duties, judicial summons, bicycle commuting day).

evidence.quote: Conceder al trabajador y trabajadora las licencias remuneradas necesarias para los siguientes casos:

obligations.summary: Employer must implement reasonable accommodations for workers with disabilities at the workplace.

evidence.quote: Implementar ajustes razonables para garantizar el goce y ejercicio de los derechos de las personas con discapacidad

obligations.summary: Employer must implement actions guided by the Public Employment Service Unit within 12 months to remove barriers to access and retention of employment.

evidence.quote: Implementar acciones guiadas por la Unidad del Servicio Público de Empleo, en un término de doce (12) meses

obligations.summary: Employer must grant preferential relocation within the company to women workers who are victims of partner or family violence, as far as possible.

evidence.quote: Otorgar en la medida de sus posibilidades el derecho preferente de reubicación en la empresa

obligations.summary: Employers with up to 500 workers must hire or keep at least two workers with disabilities per 100 workers; above 500 workers, one additional per each block of 100. Obligation is optional in the first year and mandatory from the second year.
obligations.applies_from: second year after entry into force (optional in the first year)

evidence.provision: Art. 15 num. 17 and par. 3 (adding Art. 57 CST)
evidence.quote: deberán contratar o mantener contratados, según corresponda, al menos dos (2) trabajadores con discapacidad por cada 100 trabajadores.

obligations.summary: Employer must report contracts with workers with disabilities to the Ministry of Labour within 15 days of signing.
obligations.applies_from: second year after entry into force (per Art. 15 par. 3)

evidence.quote: El empleador deberá reportar los contratos de trabajo celebrados con personas con discapacidad, dentro de los quince días siguientes a su celebración

obligations.summary: Managerial powers of subordination may not be used as a factor of discrimination on listed grounds (sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, disability, health condition, political or religious preferences, union membership, among others).

evidence.quote: Aquellas facultades no pueden constituirse en un factor de discriminación

obligations.summary: Ministry of Labour must carry out administrative actions and sanctions for discriminatory use of subordination powers.

evidence.quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo adelantará las actuaciones administrativas correspondientes y sancionará de acuerdo con las normas vigentes

obligations.summary: Employers must guarantee that pregnant workers are not required to perform physically strenuous tasks and must keep or relocate them to suitable work without salary reduction.

evidence.quote: es obligación de los empleadores garantizar la permanencia y la reubicación en un puesto de trabajo acorde con su estado

obligations.summary: Employer may not discriminate against workers who are victims of gender-based violence (num. 12), dismiss or pressure resignation on religious, political, racial, ethnic or mental-health grounds (nums. 13, 15), or limit religious or political freedom (num. 14).

evidence.quote: Despedir o presionar la renuncia de las personas trabajadoras por razones de carácter religioso, político, racial y/o étnico.

obligations.summary: Prevention and care actions, protocols, committees and mechanisms must be guaranteed against violence and harassment in the world of work, including gender-based violence and sexual harassment; the addressee is not named in the text.

evidence.quote: Se garantizarán acciones de prevención y atención, con protocolos, comités, herramientas y mecanismos necesarios

obligations.summary: Ministry of Labour must supervise compliance with the anti-harassment rules and sanction non-compliance under Laws 1010/2006, 1257/2008 and 2365/2024; the National Government must comply with Art. 12 of Law 1257/2008.

evidence.quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo vigilará y sancionará su incumplimiento

obligations.summary: Ministry of Labour must formulate a public policy with protocols, plans, programmes and strategies against violence, harassment and discrimination at work.

evidence.quote: formulará una política pública que contemple unos protocolos, planes, programas y estrategias

obligations.summary: In every labour relation, public or private, equal working conditions without discrimination must be guaranteed to reintegrated and reincorporated persons from the armed conflict.

evidence.quote: En toda relación laboral, pública o privada, se deberá garantizarla igualdad de condiciones laborales sin discriminación alguna

obligations.summary: Ministry of Labour with other bodies must develop strategies and measures to promote formal employment of reintegrated persons.

evidence.quote: desarrollarán, promoverán y adoptarán estrategias y medidas orientadas a fomentar la inserción laboral formal de esta población

obligations.summary: Ministry of Labour must issue the regulation recognising productive and occupational activities in prisons as prior work experience.

evidence.quote: El Ministerio de Trabajo en un término de 6 meses expedirá la reglamentación necesaria

obligations.summary: Sponsoring company must pay apprentices a monthly support of at least 75% of the minimum wage in the first year and 100% in the second for dual training, and at least 75%/100% for lective/practical phases of traditional training; health coverage and risk affiliation as dependent employees.

evidence.quote: el aprendiz recibirá de la empresa un apoyo de sostenimiento mensual

obligations.summary: Practical or dual phase time of apprentices must be certified by the company and recognised as work experience.

evidence.quote: El tiempo correspondiente a la fase práctica o dual deberá ser certificado por la empresa

obligations.summary: ADRES must pay the monthly remuneration of medical interns during the compulsory rotating internship; contributions are based on one minimum monthly wage.

evidence.quote: el cual será pagado por la Administradora de los Recursos del Sistema General de Seguridad Social en Salud (ADRES)

obligations.summary: Companies obliged to meet the apprenticeship quota must pay SENA a monthly amount of 1.5 minimum monthly wages per apprentice not hired, pro rata for partial monetisation.

evidence.quote: tendrán que cancelar al SENA un valor mensual

obligations.summary: SENA must submit an annual report to the seventh committees of Congress on beneficiaries and allocation of monetisation resources, with a copy to the Comptroller General.

evidence.quote: el SENA deberá rendir un informe anual a las comisiones séptimas del Congreso

obligations.summary: Platform companies must clearly inform delivery workers, in plain language, of the scope of their working modality (dependent or independent), and give prior notice of any material contract change with reasons and a chance to comment.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation and implementation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: deberán informar de manera clara y en un lenguaje sencillo a los trabajadores digitales en servicios de reparto el alcance de la modalidad de trabajo

obligations.summary: Exclusivity clauses may not be agreed for delivery activities in the independent modality; platform companies must guarantee the right to rest.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: no podrán pactarse cláusulas de exclusividad para el desarrollo de las actividades de reparto

obligations.summary: Platform companies must create a full-identity recognition mechanism for each delivery worker and a record of subscription or terms, respecting habeas data.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: deberán crear un mecanismo de reconocimiento de identidad plena que permita individualizar al trabajador digital en servicios de reparto

obligations.summary: ICT Ministry must support and create technical tools needed by the Labour Ministry for labour inspection; the coordination must be regulated within 12 months.

evidence.quote: apoyará y creará las herramientas técnicas especializadas que requiera el Ministerio del Trabajo

obligations.summary: For dependent delivery workers, platform companies must pay social security contributions in the statutory proportions; for independent workers, the platform pays 60% of health and pension contributions and all occupational risk cover, with the contribution base at 40% of platform income.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: la empresa de plataforma digital de reparto concurrirá en el pago de aportes a salud y pensión en 60%

obligations.summary: Platform companies must generate effective-service hour reports for the collection entities, and deliver them to each worker at the end of every month.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: Esta información deberá ser entregada al trabajador digital en servicios de reparto al final de cada mes.

obligations.summary: Labour and Health Ministries must regulate the contribution method for independent delivery workers earning less than the minimum daily wage per month.

evidence.quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo y el Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social reglamentará la forma de cotización

obligations.summary: Every platform company must register with the Labour Ministry and report quarterly the number of active workers in dependent and independent modalities.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: Toda empresa de plataformas digitales de reparto tendrá que realizar su inscripción ante el Ministerio del Trabajo

obligations.summary: Platforms must inform delivery workers about automated monitoring systems and automated decision systems affecting working conditions (access to orders, income, OSH, working time, promotion, account suspension), in a concise, plain-language document.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: Las empresas de plataformas digitales de reparto deberán informar a los trabajadores y trabajadoras digitales sobre:

obligations.summary: Platforms may process personal data of delivery workers only for purposes included in the data processing authorisation accepted by the worker, presented in plain language.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: solamente tratarán datos personales de los trabajadores y trabajadoras digitales en servicios de reparto para finalidades que estén contempladas en la autorización

obligations.summary: Platforms must periodically supervise and evaluate the impact on working conditions of individual decisions taken or supported by automated systems.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: supervisarán y evaluarán periódicamente el impacto que tienen en las condiciones de trabajo las decisiones individuales

obligations.summary: Delivery workers have the right to request human review of any decision made or supported by an automated decision system affecting their service conditions.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: tendrán derecho a solicitar revisión humana de cualquier decisión hecha o soportada por un sistema automatizado de toma de decisiones

obligations.summary: Platforms may not suspend, restrict or cancel a delivery worker's account, or withhold remuneration, without justification; terms may not discriminate on listed grounds (health, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, politics, nationality, union membership).
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
obligations.conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

evidence.quote: no podrá ser suspendido, restringido o cancelado de la plataforma o retenida su remuneración injustificadamente

obligations.summary: Labour Ministry through SENA, with other ministries, must design, formulate and implement a rural work training programme to certify ancestral and empirical knowledge.

evidence.quote: diseñarán, formularán e implementarán un programa de formación para el trabajo rural

obligations.summary: Domestic workers must be engaged under a written employment contract and registered in PILA; PILA registration has publicity effects only and is not a condition of validity.

evidence.quote: los trabajadores y las trabajadoras del servicio doméstico deben ser vinculadas mediante contrato de trabajo escrito

obligations.summary: ICT Ministry must develop guidelines for an information system to register domestic workers within 12 months.

evidence.quote: desarrollará los lineamientos para crear un sistema de información para dicho registro

obligations.summary: Microenterprises using partial-time social security contributions must register at their Chamber of Commerce, keep accounting books of income and expenses, and keep an internal register of employment contracts.

evidence.quote: creando libros de contabilidad en los que registre ingresos y gastos

obligations.summary: National Government must prioritise and protect listed sectors (hotels, restaurants, bars, agriculture, tourism, transport, pharmacies) in the partial-time contribution scheme.

evidence.quote: El Gobierno nacional priorizará y protegerá a los sectores de hotelería, restaurantes, bares, agricultura, turismo y transporte

obligations.summary: Employers with up to 50 employees, or larger firms whose sales growth over two years is at or below CPI, may receive the CREA EMPLEO benefit for new full-time jobs, subject to listed conditions.
obligations.conditional_on: Benefit for up to six months per new job; subject to unemployment rate above OECD average

evidence.quote: Podrán ser beneficiarias aquellas Empresas con hasta 50 empleados al momento de la postulación

obligations.summary: Financial institutions carry out the disbursement of CREA EMPLEO resources in coordination with the Labour Ministry; employers apply through their deposit-account institution with listed documents.

evidence.quote: Las entidades financieras realizarán la dispersión de los recursos en coordinación con el Ministerio del Trabajo.

obligations.summary: Health Ministry, DIAN, Civil Registry and Chambers of Commerce must send listed databases to UGPP to validate applicants for the CREA EMPLEO benefit.

evidence.quote: deberán enviar la información correspondiente a la Unidad Administrativa Especial de Gestión Pensional y Contribuciones Parafiscales de la Protección Social (UGPP)

obligations.summary: Labour Ministry must issue a binding operating manual setting the calendar, transfer mechanism, certification and restitution procedures for CREA EMPLEO.

evidence.quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo, mediante un Manual Operativo vinculante, establecerá el calendario

obligations.summary: Government must formulate a public policy supporting agricultural work within the first year after entry into force, and present a bill regulating agricultural contracts within 6 months.
obligations.applies_from: first year after entry into force

evidence.quote: el estado formulará una política pública de apoyo al trabajo agropecuario

obligations.summary: Government must present to Congress, within 6 months, a bill regulating agricultural contracts and the agricultural day wage.

evidence.quote: presentará al Congreso de la República un proyecto de ley que regule los contratos agropecuarios

obligations.summary: Employment must facilitate migration regularisation for foreign workers once a contract is signed; the Foreign Ministry must regulate the process within 6 months.

evidence.quote: se facilitará la regulación migratoria de la persona trabajadora

obligations.summary: Foreign workers in regulated professions must prove academic and professional suitability before the Education Ministry, as set out by the Ministry.

evidence.quote: quienes deberán acreditar su idoneidad académica y profesional de acuerdo con los estándares internacionales ante el Ministerio de Educación Nacional

obligations.summary: Entities running emergency-response, reforestation and afforestation policies must fill at least 50% of required jobs with local or specially protected persons; the addressee is described generically in the text.

evidence.quote: deberán contar con un mínimo del 50% de los puestos de trabajo que se requieran cubiertos por personal de la región

obligations.summary: Professional sports clubs and organisations must engage professional athletes and technical staff under a special employment contract.

evidence.quote: deberán ser vinculados y vinculadas por estas mediante contrato de trabajo especial

obligations.summary: Labour and Interior Ministries must promote participation spaces within 12 months to build the instrument for decent work of ethnic communities.

evidence.quote: los Ministerios de Trabajo e Interior propiciarán los espacios de participación

obligations.summary: Contracts for arts and culture workers must be in writing, specify object, duration, pay and pay days, and carry the same rights as labour contracts; without express written terms the relationship is indefinite.

evidence.quote: Debe formalizarse por escrito en cualquiera de sus modalidades

obligations.summary: Employers of journalists and media workers must grant a compensatory rest day when the mandatory rest day is not enjoyed, and provide everything needed with occupational safety and health conditions.

evidence.quote: el empleador deberá concederle el correspondiente día de descanso compensatorio

obligations.summary: Labour Ministry with the Commerce Ministry must create first-job and last-job programmes with incentives for firms, within 6 months.

evidence.quote: dentro de los seis (6) meses posteriores a la entrada en vigencia de la presente Ley

obligations.summary: User companies may not conclude commercial contracts with temporary service companies for situations other than those set out in the article, nor extend a specific service once its cause subsists.

evidence.provision: Art. 45 par. 1 (adding to Art. 77 Law 50 of 1990)
evidence.quote: Las empresas usuarias no podrán celebrar contratos comerciales con las empresas de servicios temporales para desarrollar situaciones diferentes

obligations.summary: Contracts with workers placed by temporary service companies must specify the cause that gave rise to the placement.

evidence.quote: En el contrato con el trabajador en misión, se debe especificar la causa que dio lugar a su vinculación

obligations.summary: Employer must respond within 15 working days to a request for flexible hours or remote work by workers with caregiving responsibilities, either accepting with an implementation process or refusing with justification or proposing an alternative.

evidence.quote: estará obligado a otorgar una respuesta en un término máximo de quince (15) días hábiles

obligations.summary: Employer may not use fraudulently the differentiated prerogatives granted to certain sectors or to micro and small firms in order to undermine labour rights.

evidence.quote: se prohíbe al empleador el uso fraudulento de las prerrogativas diferenciadas

obligations.summary: Labour and Interior Ministries, with the Victims Unit, must create, regulate and implement a labour-agreements programme for conflict victims within 12 months.

evidence.quote: creará, reglamentará e implementará el programa de convenios laborales con enfoque diferencial

obligations.summary: Public entities and contractors of publicly funded projects are to seek a minimum of 10% of required jobs filled by local personnel, prioritising conflict victims, PDET and ZOMAC municipalities.

evidence.quote: procurarán, contar con un mínimo del 10% de sus puestos de trabajo que se requieran cubiertos por personal de la región

obligations.summary: Labour Ministry must set, within 12 months, guidelines for green-growth labour skills, including worker training in sustainable practices.

evidence.quote: en el término de doce (12) meses contados a partir de la entrada en vigencia de la presente Ley, los lineamientos

obligations.summary: Labour Ministry through SENA must train and build capacity of workers for green and blue jobs, with priority to sectors in transition and to women, youth and older adults.

evidence.quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo a través del SENA formará y capacitará a los trabajadores y trabajadoras

obligations.summary: For transnational telework (work from abroad under a Colombian contract), the employer must hold insurance covering at least health care benefits in case of accident or illness.

evidence.provision: Art. 52 (replacing Art. 2 Law 1221 of 2008, lit. d)
evidence.quote: responsabilidad del empleador contar con un seguro que cubra al menos las prestaciones asistenciales en salud

obligations.summary: Employer must grant a connectivity allowance to teleworkers earning less than two minimum wages, replacing the transport allowance; only one such allowance may be received.

evidence.quote: El empleador deberá otorgar el reconocimiento de un auxilio de conectividad

obligations.summary: Occupational risk administrators must guarantee coverage of work accidents and occupational diseases of transnational teleworkers in the country where they work.

evidence.provision: Art. 54 (adding num. 14 to Art. 6 Law 1221 of 2008)
evidence.quote: Las Administradoras de Riesgos Laborales deberán garantizar la cobertura

obligations.summary: Employer must provide training programmes for teleworkers on technological tools, time management and remote communication skills.

evidence.provision: Art. 54 (adding num. 15 to Art. 6 Law 1221 of 2008)
evidence.quote: El empleador deberá proporcionar programas de formación y capacitación para teletrabajadores

obligations.summary: National Government must regulate incentives for remote work modalities within one year after the law's approval.
obligations.applies_from: 1 year after approval of the law

evidence.quote: los incentivos reglamentados por el Gobierno nacional dentro del año siguiente a la aprobación de la presente Ley

obligations.summary: Employer must permit the entry of assistance, emotional support or therapeutic animals when the worker presents a certificate issued by a psychologist or psychiatrist.

evidence.quote: El ingreso de animales de asistencia, apoyo emocional o uso terapéutico deberá ser permitido por el empleador

obligations.summary: Labour and Health Ministries must issue guidelines within 12 months for responsible animal keeping in workplaces.

evidence.quote: expedirá dentro de los doce (12) meses siguientes a la entrada en vigencia de la presente ley, los lineamientos

obligations.summary: The State, through the Labour Ministry, must implement a public policy on labour protection and transition in the face of automation.

evidence.quote: implementará una política pública de protección y transición laboral ante la automatización

obligations.summary: State, in coordination with mining, oil and energy firms, must promote and support closure plans and labour protection for workers affected by decarbonisation; the policy must include incentives, protection mechanisms, reconversion and financing.

evidence.quote: promoverá y respaldará la formulación de planes de cierre y protección de derechos laborales para todos los trabajadores

obligations.summary: Health and Labour Ministries must make technical adjustments to PILA within 6 months to allow partial-time and concurrent contributions.
obligations.applies_from: 6 months after expedition of the law

evidence.quote: deberán reglamentar lo dispuesto en el presente artículo en un término de seis (6) meses

obligations.summary: Government must regulate within 6 months the mechanisms guaranteeing social security affiliation for agricultural employers and their dependent workers.

evidence.quote: reglamentará, en un plazo no mayor a seis (6) meses

obligations.summary: Labour Ministry must promote within 12 months a support programme for micro and small firms and a programme to promote labour formalisation.

evidence.quote: el Ministerio del Trabajo impulsará un programa de acompañamiento y fortalecimiento a micro y pequeñas empresas

obligations.summary: Employer may deposit monthly into the severance fund 8.33% of the base salary as an advance deposit, and parties may agree to monthly payment of severance interest of 1%.

evidence.provision: Art. 64 (adding par. 1 to Art. 99 Law 50 of 1990)
evidence.quote: El empleador podrá aportar mensualmente con destino al fondo de cesantías el 8.33%

obligations.summary: Dependent workers in extreme poverty, moderate poverty or vulnerability may remain in the subsidised health regime for 6 months while formalised.
obligations.conditional_on: Population in extreme poverty, moderate poverty or vulnerability per government targeting

evidence.quote: podrán permanecer en el régimen subsidiado de salud por un plazo de 6 meses

obligations.summary: Labour Ministry through the Public Service Unit must promote an employability programme creating placement services for those completing qualification programmes.

evidence.quote: fomentará un programa para la promoción de la empleabilidad

obligations.summary: The employability programme must present an annual report to the Permanent Concertation Commission on goal fulfilment and impact measurement.

evidence.quote: se presentará un informe anual sobre el cumplimiento de metas y medición de impacto

obligations.summary: ICBF must progressively employ community mothers, childcare-centre workers and substitute mothers, with a progression schedule set within 12 months; full implementation targeted for 2029 subject to budget.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months after entry into force (progression schedule)

evidence.quote: El ICBF establecerá la progresividad para la vinculación de las y los trabajadores en un término no mayor a doce (12) meses

obligations.summary: The School Feeding Programme operator must ensure that food handlers are formalised as workers, in four annual stages: 25% in 2025.
obligations.conditional_on: Subject to the Medium-Term Fiscal Framework
